Standard: The seating and restraint system restrains occupants during static and dynamic loading. The seating and restraint system, including structural attachment to the air vehicle, withstands static and dynamic loads defined in MIL-STD-1290, Pilot and Copilot paragraph and Cabin paragraph, with a maximum weight nude occupant of the representative anthropometric range not less than 250 lbs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: Static loads: Test that the seat and restraint system with associated air vehicle structure restrains seated occupants during static loading. Verify the static load capabilities of the seat and restraint system with associated air vehicle structure and a seated occupant per MIL- STD-1290, Pilot and Copilot paragraph and Cabin paragraph.
(2) Lab test: Dynamic loads: Test that the seat and restraint system with associated air vehicle structure restrains seated occupants during dynamic loading. Verify the dynamic load capabilities of the seat and restraint system with associated air vehicle structure and a seated occupant per MIL-STD-1290, Pilot and Copilot paragraph and Cabin paragraph.
